items.quote: Thank you Santiago for the excellent work performed on my vehicles. I look forward in doing business again with you in the near future. I am recommending you to my friends and colleagues.

We had Ovisan Car Detailing come out to fully detail our company fleet of four vans, and we couldn't be more impressed! He was professional, took his time, and paid attention to every detail. The vans looked and smelled like new!

Santiago did full interior and exterior on my mustang. Main concern was my cloth seats, extremely dirty. I didn't expect that my seats would be as clean as they are now. The price is very fair for the work done.
